Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision in which their vehicle was struck while the patient was turning left. Complaints
centered on low back pain with muscle guarding and reduced range of motion in the lumbar region. The mechanism
of injury and the force involved are consistent with the lumbar strain diagnosed. Imaging and physical examination
findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient mentioned a minor strain to the same area several years
ago, which resolved completely without lasting limitation. Care was delivered over three visits, consisting of manual
therapy, guided stretching, and activity modification. Treatment followed a typical cuorse and was reduced in
frequency as symptoms improved. At the most recent visit the patient reported near-normal function with minimal
residual discomfort. Billing records reflect single charges for each service, with no duplicate or repeated entries.
Prognosis is good, with return to full activity anticipated and discharge from active care planned if improvement
continues.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
